title: Route new-list creation through shoppingListsURL in ShoppingListsView
description: Update the new shopping list file URL construction in ShoppingListsView.swift (around line 68) to use ShoppingListFiles.shoppingListsURL(in:).appendingPathComponent so new lists are written to <folder>/shopping-lists/<sanitised>.md. No other call sites (read, write, delete, displayName) need changing as they operate on fully-qualified URLs.
acceptance_criteria: New shopping lists are created at <folder>/shopping-lists/<name>.md
The shopping-lists/ directory is auto-created on first list creation if absent (via shoppingListsURL)
No changes to read, write, delete, or displayName call sites
